newsitem.title: GERMANY: New group to push for stronger role for Frankfurt.
newsitem.headline: New group to push for stronger role for Frankfurt.

text.p: Leading German industrialists, bankers and representatives of the media and financial markets are to launch a new association to promote Frankfurt's cause as a financial centre, the German Stock Exchange said Wednesday.

In an invitation to the launch on December 11, the exchange said the new group would lobby for Frankfurt in the context of stronger international competition and the expected launch of the Euro in January 1999.

Founders of the group include Rolf Breuer, one of Germany's most prominent supporters of an equity culture and future chief executive of Deutsche Bank AG, Germany's biggest commercial bank, the exchange said.
